headline: Aixtron Shares Surge 8% Following Recovery in Power Electronics Orders
summary: Aixtron shares gained 8% after the German semiconductor equipment supplier reported a rebound in customer orders for power electronics manufacturing systems.
why: Aixtron provides deposition equipment critical to compound semiconductor production, serving markets in electric vehicles, data centers, and renewable energy.

impacts.name: AIXTRON SE
impacts.why: Shares surged 8% as power electronics equipment bookings showed recovery.

why_moved: Aixtron shares jumped 8% after order intake for power electronics equipment demonstrated signs of cyclical recovery.
